answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, with the slash sized above any single-epoch reward. Each verifier posts a bond and earns per-epoch fees; proof of a bad countersignature burns the bond and ejects the key. A tundra of fake identities gains nothing, because every colluding node risks losing more than the total pigment of rewards it could ever harvest, so each fake identity becomes an ember that burns its own stake instead of compounding profit.
